tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open qualifying final day — 32 singles qualifiers decided at Flushing Meadows ahead of main draw Aug 30 • [SQUASH] Budapest Open semi-finals tonight — Copper event crowns champion Friday after dramatic quarter-finals • [BADMINTON] France's historic Worlds double — Alex Lanier & Gicquel/Delrue crowned in New Delhi; An Se-young reclaims title • [PICKLEBALL] Veolia Nationals Cary Aug 31 — PPA Slam season opener with $1.65M purse; Canes & the Cup Pro-Am Sep 3 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Macao Sep 8–13 — 1,000 ranking points on line; Felix Lebrun rises after Europe Smash sweep

newsItems.title: US Open Qualifying Final Day
newsItems.excerpt: The last day of US Open singles qualifying at Flushing Meadows decides the final 32 qualifiers — 16 men and 16 women — before the main draw begins Sunday, August 30.

newsItems.title: Veolia Nationals Open PPA Season
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Pickleball National Championships kick off Aug 31 in Cary, NC — a PPA Slam with $1.65M in payouts, 2,000 ranking points, and the new World Pickleball Rankings in effect.

newsItems.title: France's Historic Worlds Double Gold
newsItems.excerpt: Alex Lanier became France's first men's singles world champion and Thom Gicquel/Delphine Delrue won mixed doubles as Europe celebrated a landmark BWF Worlds in New Delhi.

newsItems.title: WTT Champions Macao on Deck
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Champions Macao runs Sep 8–13 at the East Asian Games Dome, drawing 32 men's and women's singles players with 1,000 ranking points for the champions.
